digest.component_or_area: Core reconciler transport routing & backend abstraction
propositions: Core reconciler modules construct AcliClient inline rather than routing through Backend port abstraction, hardcoding Jira as a concrete dependency.
Transport construction sites (applier, fetcher, run_differs, _attestation) require refactoring to obtain client via select_backend().transport instead of direct instantiation.
Provider-identity literals ('jira' strings) are scattered across apply_inbound_records.py and other modules instead of sourced from the selected backend's vendor field.
Vendor-specific field mappers and constants (ADF-sizing, value-maps, link relations) leak into core importer logic instead of being relocated to adapters/jira.
After routing through Backend port, all four transport seams and apply_inbound_records must contain zero direct AcliClient constructions and exactly one hardcoded 'jira' token (vocabulary key).
